name: Cathedrons Cathedral Registry
exclusiveNote: Exclusive relics only drop at their cathedral. Parish churches never grant these.

cathedrals.title: St Paul's Cathedral
cathedrals.narrationText: St Paul's. Dome like a sealed rose. The Devout once synched here under the whisper of the great window.

cathedrals.title: Westminster Abbey
cathedrals.narrationText: Westminster. Crowns and bones. A Cathedron seal sleeps under the choir.

cathedrals.title: Southwark Cathedral
cathedrals.narrationText: Southwark by the river. Pilgrims once crossed here. The nail still remembers the tide.

cathedrals.title: Canterbury Cathedral
cathedrals.narrationText: Canterbury. Becket's shadow. The shrine is gone; the letter of power remains.

cathedrals.title: Basilica of St Nicholas
cathedrals.narrationText: St Nicholas on the harbour. The first Cathedron brief was drawn from this silhouette.
